plugin.name: themed-open-close
plugin._long: Adds the effect "pop" for opening and closing windows to the animate plugin: the window grows to its size from a little smaller as it fades in. Choose it with animate's open_animation and close_animation options. A window the desktop expects from one of its icons grows out of that icon instead, and the effect "icon-zoom" takes it back into the icon as it closes while every other window closes at once.

option.name: pop_duration
option._long: How long the pop effect takes, and its curve.

option.name: icon_zoom_ms
option._long: How long a window takes to grow out of a desktop icon or back into it, in milliseconds, eased in and out.
